sections.title: A mobile Okanagan booking is different from a Kelowna studio
sections.html:
A Kelowna search can surface a travelling analyst based elsewhere in the Okanagan or Shuswap. That may be convenient for a pair or group, but it is not evidence of a permanent local studio. Compare the minimum booking, travel arrangement and space requirements with a self-guided app.

Muse by Laura Lye

This provider is based in Gleneden near Salmon Arm and explicitly offers mobile appointments to Kelowna by arrangement. The listed mobile rate is C$150 per person with a minimum of two people, making the base booking C$300. Confirm travel charges and availability before committing.

sections.title: Treat the location as a mobile arrangement
sections.html:
Before gathering a group, ask whether the proposed address is within the service area and what the final total includes. Confirm the number of guests, individual appointment time, lighting requirements and cancellation terms. Do not assume that a quoted per-person amount means the analyst will travel for one person at that rate.

  • What is the total for a Kelowna visit, including any travel charges?
  • What minimum group size, space and lighting are required?

sections.title: Give each guest an individual purpose
sections.html: If you are exploring alone, use a phone palette to identify the specific questions you would want to ask. If a friend also wants a consultation, compare your goals before booking together. After the session, each person should leave with their own useful combinations and references. Sharing the appointment can spread travel logistics, but it does not make the same colors work for everyone.

sections.title: When hosting adds more work than value
sections.html:
The Kelowna service area is not a claim that the provider has a permanent Kelowna studio. That distinction matters for scheduling and for the cost of an appointment for just one person. Ask whether another arrangement is available rather than quietly assuming the two-person minimum can be ignored.

If you want to begin alone, Stylist AI needs neither a host nor a second attendee. Start with its guided selfie flow, explore the seasonal palette and outfit combinations, then look through makeup and hair previews. Its camera tool adds a way to compare garment colours later. A mobile consultant offers live physical comparisons in an agreed space; the app offers independent exploration. Choose according to whether you need that personal visit.

editorial.leadHtml:
Before inviting anyone

  • Confirm the provider can travel on your proposed date.
  • Ask which travel charges apply to your actual address.
  • Get the room and lighting requirements from the analyst.
  • Agree on payment and what happens if the second guest cancels.
